item.title: Mountain Bike Club Meetings and Activities
item.description:
The Mountain Bike Club meets after school in Room 511 from 2:15-3:30 PM for seven sessions starting September 3rd. item.title: Student Vaccination Requirements and Deadline
item.description:
All students must provide proof of Tdap (Tetanus, Diphtheria, and Pertussis) and Meningococcal vaccines or an exemption by September 9, 2026. These vaccinations are required by the state of Ohio for all 7th grade students. Students without proof will be excluded from school until documentation is provided. Contact your healthcare provider or Becky Hart RN at TMS clinic at 513-273-3314 with questions.

item.title: Glen Helen 7th Grade Trip Information
item.description:
The 7th grade Glen Helen overnight camp requires a $50 deposit by Friday, August 28, 2026 (total cost $165, balance $115). Students must submit both a Commitment Letter and Discipline Contract by this deadline. Additional paperwork (health form, photo waiver) and full payment are due by Friday, September 11, 2026. Medical permits must be turned in three days before departure with correct medication paperwork. The trip uses a 3-strike behavior system at Glen Helen, with no refund if a child is removed for behavior. Starting August 31st, a similar behavior system applies at school leading up to the trip—a 3rd offense results in removal from the trip with full refund available prior to September 15, 2026, partial refund after. Students who receive in-school or out-of-school suspension will be immediately suspended from the trip. Payment options include cash, check (to Talawanda Middle School), or pie sale/cookie dough fundraiser earnings.

Students can pick up permission slips from Mrs. Ruppert in Room 406.

item.title: Older Americans Month Community BINGO
item.description:
May is Older Americans Month with the theme "Champion Your Health." Oxford Seniors, Age-Friendly Oxford, and the Coalition for a Healthy Community are hosting Community BINGO throughout May. Pick up a BINGO card at Oxford Seniors (922 Tollgate Dr.), Oxford Lane Library (441 S. Locust St.), or The Knolls of Oxford, complete activities listed on the card, and bring your completed card to the Intergenerational BINGO Party on Sunday, May 31 from 3:00-5:00 p.m. at Oxford Seniors for prizes and snacks. Get BINGO by marking off any 5 squares in a straight line (vertically, horizontally, or diagonally).

item.title: Oxford Swim and Dive Team Registration
item.description:
The Oxford Swim and Dive Team is a community summer competitive program for ages 4-18 of all abilities. Practices begin May 26, 2026 at the Oxford Aquatic Center with various schedules for different age groups. Registration costs: Swim Team $150, Dive $120, Swim & Dive $200 (discounts available for multiple children; pool membership required). A trial period is available May 26-29 for $30. Additionally, Coach Steve offers a Makos Stroke Clinic at Miami's Rec Center for swimmers ages 5-13, April 20 - May 22, 2026, and Dive Well practice on Mondays, Wednesdays & Fridays 5:30-6:30 pm (Spring Session $180). Register at swimosdt.com or contact oxfordswimdive@gmail.com.
